concept.feedback: The proposal meets all listed gates. Its locally defined checksum-based target is appropriately treated as the benchmark success condition, with no unnecessary external-title requirement.

findings.detail: The stranded desert expedition, relay pylons, emergency beacons, field logs, and signal reconstruction are directly compatible with the expedition_signal family.
The proposal defines the setting, evidence sources, six evidence dimensions, local checksum rule, target concept, and target question without requiring an external role definition.
A sandstorm-disrupted expedition reconstructing a corrupted distress-call relay chain provides a coherent narrative reason to inspect the evidence.
No participant is named, privileged by role, or signaled through narrative prominence; the intended answer is explicitly deferred to formalization and deterministic computation.
The premise explicitly enumerates all six evidence streams and states that their statuses feed the iterated modular checksum.
